{"command": "cd /mnt/data/git/pi-mega-compact && git commit -m "refactor(mega-runtime): Phase 2 decomposition — split widget.ts + extract runtime helpers/snapshot

Phase 2a — split widget.ts (~422 → 172 + 218 + 81 lines):
  - widget-types.ts: TickerEntry + WidgetData interfaces (pure types)
  - widget-ansi.ts: C palette, PULSE, panel layout + ambient border-effect
    helpers, token/time formatters (moved verbatim, now exported)
  - widget.ts: thin barrel — owns buildWidgetLines() + re-exports from
    widget-ansi.ts/widget-types.ts so no consumer import changed

Phase 2b — extract runtime.ts private helpers (~783 → ~754 + 120 lines):
  - runtime-helpers.ts: RuntimeHelpersContext interface + materialSigImpl,
    embedderNameImpl, driftStatusImpl, getTurnLevelImpl (free functions)
  - runtime.ts: the four methods are now 1-line delegates; driftCache +
    lastSnapshotSig made public so MegaRuntime satisfies the context
    interface structurally

Phase 2c — extract snapshot() body (~289 lines → runtime-snapshot.ts):
  - runtime-snapshot.ts: snapshotImpl(ctx, extCtx) — the full snapshot
    computation (vector stats, armed/ready, dashboard.json write, widget
    refresh, material-signature gate)
  - runtime.ts: snapshot() is now a 1-line delegate to snapshotImpl

All consumer imports preserved via barrels. Verified: tsc --noEmit
passes; lint + guardrails-scan + semantic-scan clean; regression_check
clean (pre-existing .dockerignore note only); 631 tests pass across
61 files, 0 failures.
